name: HANSON, Pauline Lee

headline.note: The official biography records small-business ownership from 1978 to 1997, and public sources identify retail, clerical, construction, hospitality, food-service, primary-production, real-estate and later media/performance work. The available evidence does not establish complete dates, hours, leave or overlaps for a defensible full-time total. Local and federal elected office, party activity, directorship/property holdings and unpaid family work are excluded or treated separately. Missing evidence is not zero.

career_spells.role: Food preparation, service, bookkeeping and sales-ledger work
career_spells.evidence_note: Biographical sources say Hanson worked in her parents' Ipswich fish-and-chip shop from a young age and later helped with bookkeeping and sales ledgers. The legal employer, pay, dates and hours are not established. Follow-up2026-10-02: detailed original source inaccessible; retained as prior research requiring primary corroboration, not newly verified evidence.
career_spells.counting_note: Possible family employment cannot be counted without dates, hours and paid-status evidence.

career_spells.role: Retail worker, role not further specified
career_spells.evidence_note: The biographical chronology records work at Woolworths before office administration at Taylors Elliotts. It supplies no dates, hours, role detail or leave evidence. Follow-up2026-10-02: detailed original source inaccessible; retained as prior research requiring primary corroboration, not newly verified evidence.
career_spells.counting_note: No full-time duration can be derived.

career_spells.employer: Taylors Elliotts Ltd (Drug Houses of Australia subsidiary)
career_spells.role: Administrative clerk; bookkeeping and secretarial work
career_spells.evidence_note: Biographical sources identify the employer and clerical duties and say Hanson left during her first pregnancy. Appointment and cessation dates, hours and leave are not published. Follow-up2026-10-02: detailed original source inaccessible; retained as prior research requiring primary corroboration, not newly verified evidence.
career_spells.counting_note: Private employment is supported, but duration and full-time status are unknown.

career_spells.evidence_note: Hanson's Senate site says she and her second husband started a plumbing business in 1978, employing apprentices and tradesmen until their 1987 divorce. Other biographies identify her administrative role. Exact business commencement/liquidation, her hours and any leave are unavailable.
career_spells.counting_note: The business interval is supported at year precision, but substantive full-time work across the whole period is not.

career_spells.evidence_note: The biographical sequence places bar work at the club after Hanson's 1987 divorce and before the fish-and-chip business. The employer's legal identity, exact dates, hours and leave are not established. Follow-up2026-10-02: detailed original source inaccessible; retained as prior research requiring primary corroboration, not newly verified evidence.
career_spells.counting_note: Club/nonprofit employment is excluded from the public/private headline.

career_spells.employer: Marsden Hanson Pty Ltd / Marsden's Seafood
career_spells.role: Co-owner then owner; administration, purchasing, food preparation and service
career_spells.evidence_note: Biographical sources say Hanson and Morrie Marsden opened the Silkstone fish-and-chip/catering business after 1987, that Hanson later gained full control, and that it was sold on her 1996 election. The official biography's broader small-business period is 1978-1997. Exact purchase, ownership-transfer and sale dates, hours and leave remain unresolved. April1997 ministerial answer reports business workers compensation cover current to30June1997. This requires reconciliation with the reported1996sale; insurance alone does not prove continued personal work or justify extending the employment interval.
career_spells.counting_note: Substantive private business activity is well supported, but evidence does not establish a precise full-time interval.

career_spells.evidence_note: One Nation's biography says Hanson ran a potato-chip processing business before federal politics, but gives no legal entity, dates, hours, continuity or relationship to her other businesses.
career_spells.counting_note: The undated business cannot contribute to a duration.

career_spells.evidence_note: One Nation's biography calls Hanson a primary producer with cattle, and contemporary reporting in 2002 described plans to raise cattle. The property, legal entity, commercial activity, dates, hours and continuity are not established.
career_spells.counting_note: Ownership or primary-production activity without a bounded substantive workload is insufficient for the headline.

career_spells.evidence_note: The official parliamentary biography records local-government service from 1994 to 1995, overlapping operation of the food business.
career_spells.counting_note: Elected office is excluded from the employment headlines.

career_spells.evidence_note: Official parliamentary service covers the 1996 election through defeat at the 1998 election.
career_spells.counting_note: Federal elected office is excluded.

career_spells.employer: Pauline Hanson's One Nation and Pauline's United Australia Party
career_spells.role: Founder, leader, candidate and party office-holder
career_spells.evidence_note: The span represents multiple non-continuous periods of party leadership, candidacy and organisation: One Nation from 1997, Pauline's United Australia Party from 2007 to 2010, and renewed One Nation leadership from 2014. It is not evidence of continuous paid employment; remuneration, hours and campaign gaps are unresolved.
career_spells.counting_note: Party organisation and candidacy are excluded.

career_spells.employer: The Professionals, Annerley agency; legal entity unresolved
career_spells.evidence_note: Contemporary February2006 reporting says she began at Professionals Annerley late the previous year. Domain retrospectively confirms2006 activity, not cessation; replaced unsupported2006 end. Year precision preserves late2005 without inventing a month. Franchise legal entity, payroll/commission terms, hours and end remain unknown.
career_spells.counting_note: A year-level occupational reference without full-time or boundary evidence cannot be counted.

career_spells.employer: Don & Pauline Hanson Property Pty Ltd / related property trust
career_spells.role: Director, owner or investor; substantive employment not established
career_spells.evidence_note: ABN records show the company from 28 October 2011 and a related property trust from 2 December 2011. These records and later declared property interests establish entities/assets, not that Hanson performed substantive paid work or the amount and continuity of any workload. Withdrawn personal start date: company/trust registration dates do not establish her appointment or work commencement.
career_spells.counting_note: Directorship, ownership and investment alone do not prove full-time employment.

career_spells.evidence_note: Official parliamentary service records Senate commencement on 2 July 2016 and re-election in 2022.
career_spells.counting_note: Federal elected office is excluded.

career_spells.evidence_note: Producer confirmation establishes paid appearances before2016 election; ABC counts20 since September2015. This is an observed appearance window, not exact contract boundaries or continuous employment. Hours, contractual entity and employee/contractor status unknown.
career_spells.counting_note: Dates, substantive full-time status and/or leave remain insufficiently evidenced; no headline years calculated.

career_spells.evidence_note: ABC reports regular segment ended earlier in2019; donations went to nominated charity rather than personal remuneration. Member spokesman says no personal payment as senator. Exact beginning and transition from paid arrangement unknown.
career_spells.counting_note: Excluded category; not added to public/private employment headlines.

career_spells.evidence_note: July2019 network statement confirms appearances unpaid personally, with donations to charity. Start month/end unknown; no inference of paid media employment from donations.
career_spells.counting_note: Excluded category; not added to public/private employment headlines.

career_spells.employer: Seven Network / Dancing with the Stars; contracting producer unresolved
career_spells.evidence_note: ABC retrospective confirms participation and finalist status. Production and broadcast dates are not employment dates; fee, contract, hours and training schedule unknown.
career_spells.counting_note: Dates, substantive full-time status and/or leave remain insufficiently evidenced; no headline years calculated.

career_spells.employer: Jo-Jo Publishing / author activity; contractual entity unresolved
career_spells.evidence_note: ABC records March2007 publication, catalogue confirms authorship. Writing interval, advances/royalties and hours unknown; publication date not substituted for employment dates.
career_spells.counting_note: Dates, substantive full-time status and/or leave remain insufficiently evidenced; no headline years calculated.

career_spells.employer: Todd McKenney Live / Star City; producer and contracting entity unresolved
career_spells.evidence_note: A contemporary September 2005 account says Hanson had just appeared in the finale of Todd McKenney's stage show after being recruited following Dancing with the Stars; the performer's professional biography describes a three-week Star City season featuring Hanson. The evidence establishes a bounded performance engagement, but not the contracting entity, fee, rehearsal workload, weekly hours or exact dates.
career_spells.counting_note: A short media-performance engagement with unknown pay and hours cannot contribute to the private full-time headline.

career_spells.employer: Nine Network / Celebrity Apprentice Australia; producer and contracting entity unresolved
career_spells.evidence_note: Contemporary reporting documents Hanson's participation through her firing from Celebrity Apprentice on 15 November 2011. Coverage also distinguishes charity fundraising and a separate rejected cash offer during a task, neither of which proves her programme fee. Contracting entity, appearance fee, filming dates, hours and employee/contractor status remain unknown.
career_spells.counting_note: Television participation is part of the post-parliament work history, but no substantive full-time employment interval is established.

career_spells.employer: A Super Progressive Movie Pty Ltd / A Pauline Production Pty Ltd and Stepmates Studios; personal contracting entity unresolved
career_spells.role: Executive producer and featured performer,A Super Progressive Movie
career_spells.evidence_note: Official credits name Hanson as executive producer and featured participant. Film launch advertised26January2026; production-work dates, fee, employee/contractor basis and hours unknown. ABR records A Pauline Production as a private company active28October2025; registration is not a personal appointment. Contemporary reporting identifies her shareholding and planned donations of proceeds to One Nation, which do not prove salary or full-time work.
career_spells.counting_note: Film activity is retained separately from elected/party office. Corporate credit and ownership do not establish substantive full-time employment; no duration calculated.

research_notes: Obtain payroll or contemporaneous business records for Woolworths, Taylors Elliotts, the plumbing enterprise, Booval Bowls Club and Marsden Hanson, including exact boundaries, hours and leave.
Resolve the potato-processing enterprise and cattle primary-production legal entities, dates, commercial activity and substantive workload.

Investigate paid work and income-producing activity during the 1998-2016 gap, including the 2006 real-estate role, publications/media appearances, property entities and overlap with candidacy and party leadership.

The official 1978-1997 small-business span is preserved but not treated as one continuous full-time interval because the underlying enterprises, divorce/liquidation, club job, local office and business sale have distinct and partly unresolved boundaries.

2026-10-02 follow-up: added paid Sunrise commentary and separated later charitable/unpaid media,2004 TV participation and2007 authorship; refined Professionals to Annerley late2005 and removed unsupported cessation; withdrew company incorporation as personal start. Enough Rope410 and SCMP403 were source-only failures; indexed contemporary SCMP passage available. Early-job detail needs original autobiography/transcript corroboration, not Wikipedia mirrors. Celebrity Apprentice2011, motivational speaking2010 and stage appearances2005 remain leads requiring primary contract/producer evidence. Search found impersonator Nathy Gaffney speaker listing: rejected as not Hanson employment. No hours inferred; property ownership, charitable payments and election funding not payroll. Follow up broadcaster contracts, Annerley agency historical records and original early-career sources.

2026-10-03 follow-up: contemporary reporting resolves two post-House media-performance observations: a 2005 Todd McKenney Live stage-show engagement and 2011 Celebrity Apprentice participation through 15 November. Both are coded as private-sector activity with unknown paid basis, contracting entity and hours; charity fundraising or a rejected task-specific cash offer is not personal remuneration evidence. Searches for original early-career payroll records, Celebrity Apprentice fees, 2010 speaking contracts and the Annerley agency did not resolve further boundaries. Next: Nine/Seven production credits or contracts, Star City programme archives, original autobiography pages and historical business filings.

2026-10-04 follow-up: exact entity/employer searches for Marsden Hanson Pty Ltd, Taylors Elliotts and Booval Bowls Club mostly returned Wikipedia mirrors and derivative biographies repeating the inaccessible early-career narrative. No original payroll, business-registry, liquidation, sale or autobiography page evidence surfaced; a 2026 anonymous Reddit recollection was not used. The early-job rows remain leads requiring primary corroboration. Next: ASIC historical extracts, library-accessible autobiography pages or archived employer records.

Targeted follow-up2026-10-05: Added primary-confirmed2026 film executive-production activity, with company identity from ABR and corporate-ownership context from contemporary reporting. Production dates, remuneration and workload remain unknown; registration/premiere dates and intended political donations are not employment boundaries or pay. Original memoir search still exposed derivative biographies only, so early-shop/Woolworths/Taylors/club assertions retain primary-corroboration gaps. New lead: original Senate interest declaration may identify A Pauline Production and Small Batch Brewing interests; unverified aggregator listing not adopted as a directorship or job.

Targeted second follow-up2026-10-05: original1997 Queensland question/ministerial answer provides fish-shop insurance observation; reported1996sale versus insurancecurrent1997 remains an explicit reconciliation gap, not fabricated longer work. Stafffull-time/casual wording concerns employees, not Hanson, and wageamount allegations are not adopted as verified answer facts.2026ChurchAndState video-summary lead claims full-time clerical work but lacks named employer/dates; video not watched, no FT upgrade of Taylors spell. Repaired two pre-existing missing spell IDs for2005stage engagement and2011realityshow without changing supported facts. Earlybusiness/legalentity, hours and transitions still unresolved.
